text:
alice: Heads-up — running into two related limits in us-west3 while trying to scale a new GPU nodepool for batch-inference. Need help filing quota requests and confirming network design.
ben: TL;DR what do you need increased?
alice: GPU quota (A100 v4 / a4) and more secondary IP capacity on the subnet for alias IP ranges. We're provisioning 6 new nodepools (bursty, different sizes) and the autoscaler fails with Pending pods due to IP exhaustion + then GPU quota limit.
carla: Can you paste the error from the autoscaler/pod events? Also which GKE cluster and subnet?
alice: Cluster: prod-infer-west3, subnet: projects/redwood-prod/regions/us-west3/subnetworks/prod-infer-subnet (has two secondary ranges: pod-range and svc-range)
alice: Autoscaler event copy: "0/8 nodes are available: 8 Insufficient accelerators.googleapis.com/a100_v4, 12 Insufficient resources: ephemeral port range, PodCIDR exhausted" (simplified)
ben: Ok. Two separate requests then: 1) GPUs: increase quota for accelerators.googleapis.com/a100_v4 in region us-west3 to X (we should request 24 more). 2) VPC secondary IP allocation: increase secondary range size or add a new secondary range for the subnet.
carla: For pod density we also hit the GKE maxPods-per-node default. Are you creating high-density nodes? If so consider packing more pods per node (kubelet --max-pods-per-node) but GKE sets this via node pool flag: --max-pods-per-node. Lower-level trick: increase node size to balance.
alice: We need guidance because we want varied node sizes: small (1 GPU, 24 pods), medium (2 GPUs, 60 pods), large (4 GPUs, 120 pods). The current pod secondary range is /20 (~4096 addresses) but a chunk already used by other clusters in the VPC. We don't have headroom in us-west3-subnet secondary ranges.
ben: Filing the GPU quota request is straightforward, but for alias IPs we need either: - create a new secondary range on the same subnetwork and allocate it to the nodepool, or - expand the existing secondary range (requires subnet edit and coordination). Both need GCP support for quota on subnetwork secondary ranges if you're at limits.
carla: I've prepared suggested text for support and the commands to collect current usage.
carla: "gcloud compute networks subnets describe prod-infer-subnet --region=us-west3 --project=redwood-prod --format=json"
carla: and for GPUs:
carla: ```
# check regional GPU quota
gcloud compute regions describe us-west3 --project=redwood-prod --format="json(quotas)"
# or use: gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod
``` 
ben: Also collect current reservations and nodepool sizes: `gcloud container node-pools list --cluster=prod-infer-west3 --region=us-west3 --project=redwood-prod`
alice: I've run the subnet describe — will paste the relevant bits in the ticket. Current secondary ranges: pod-range (/20, used ~2800), svc-range (/24). We can't expand pod-range because it's adjacent to another used range in the same VPC.
carla: In that case, request creation of a new secondary range like pod-range-2 (/20) and grant GKE permission to use it for the new nodepools. Include the GKE node pool creation plan.
carla: Suggested text for support ticket:
carla: ```
Hi GCP support,
Project: redwood-prod
Region: us-west3
Request: Increase accelerators.googleapis.com/a100_v4 quota by +24 and allow creation of an additional secondary IP range (pod-range-2 /20) on subnetwork prod-infer-subnet. Current pod-range is near capacity and cannot be expanded due to adjacent allocations.
Use-case: Scaling multiple GPU nodepools for batch inference with mixed pod density (1/2/4 GPU instances). Autoscaler is failing due to "Insufficient accelerators" and IP exhaustion.
Please advise if any steps are needed from our side or if you can apply the quota/secondary range change.
Thank you,
Redwood Inference infra team
``` 
ben: Nice. Add the GCP project number and estimated sustained throughput numbers for capacity planning (e.g., expected sustained GPUs: 48 gpus in region, burst to 80 during jobs) — support likes numbers.
alice: I'll add project number and peak GPU estimate. Also please cc billing/contact for quota approval delays.
gcp-support: Thanks for the ticket text — we created case 0123456789 and eyeballed the region quotas. Support rep flagged potential IP reservation conflicts; they'll coordinate with network backend. ETA 48-72h for accelerators quota review.
infra-bot: FYI — opened internal task INFRA-9423 to track quota request and nodepool rollout. Assigned to @ben and @alice. :white_check_mark:
alice: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll hold nodepool creation until support confirms the secondary range or we provision a new one. Will follow up with the ticket number and project id in this thread.
ben: If support stalls, fallback is spinning new nodepools in us-central1 where we have spare IPs and GPU quota, then migrate workloads. Not ideal for latency but doable.
carla: Also consider enabling VPC-native alias IPs in a dedicated subnet for GPU runtime to avoid cross-cluster fragmentation long-term.
alice: Noted. Will schedule a follow-up retro after this incident. :calendar:
gcp-support: Case 0123456789 — we requested +24 A100_v4 in us-west3 and initiated subnetwork secondary range creation. We'll update once engineering confirms the range allocation."
